text:
nina: Quick non-work question: if you could have one silly superpower for a day, what would it be? mine: making any snack appear from thin air. immediate peace. :sparkles: :sandwich: 

leo: portable pocket-echo. whatever i say out loud also echoes a cute supportive compliment a second later. "you got this" x2.

harry: i would have the power to instantly untangle headphones and charging cables. world peace achieved. :headphones: :wrench: 

sophie: teleporting only to coffee shops. travel is allowed but only to cafes. 

nina: love the mundane superpowers. harry that's basically my dream job.

leo: meme-bot, please deliver a celebratory GIF for "untangled cords".

meme-bot: GIF posted: https://giphy.com/gifs/FAKEGIF (tiny hero untangling cords) :tada:

harry: yes. also curious: would anyone want to swap their silly power for one day? barter time.

sophie: i'll trade teleporting-to-coffee for nina's snack-summoning. my productivity would skyrocket.

nina: trade accepted if you bring back a croissant.

leo: real talk: powers that help at home > flashy superhero stuff. batteries for life would be sick.

harry: or the ability to always find the missing sock in the laundry. 

leo: vote: which silly superpower wins this mini-poll? 1) snack-summon 2) untangle-anything 3) teleport-to-coffee 4) pocket-echo 5) other (reply with yours). react with :one: :two: :three: :four: :five:.

sophie: :three:

harry: :two:

nina: :one:

leo: :four: (i'm an echo-admirer)

meme-bot: Poll result: leading = teleport-to-coffee (2 votes)

nina: agreed, coffee teleportation wins! thanks for the smiles y'all. if anyone actually invents snack-summon please patent and file with legal. :laughing:
